name: io.github.apatilgtn/k8scortex-mcp
description: Kubernetes MCP server: 75 tools for GKE, AKS, EKS, RBAC, audit logging, GitOps, multi-cluster.

environmentVariables.name: KUBECONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to your kubeconfig file. Each context becomes a cluster. Defaults to ~/.kube/config.

environmentVariables.name: CLUSTERS_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a cluster registry JSON file mixing kubeconfig, EKS, GKE and Key Vault clusters.

environmentVariables.name: K8SCORTEX_STDIO_ROLES
environmentVariables.description: Roles for the local session, e.g. 'developer' for read-only tools. Defaults to platform-engineer.

runtimeArguments.name: --volume
runtimeArguments.description: Mount your kubeconfig directory read-only. Contexts that use exec plugins (gke-gcloud-auth-plugin, aws eks get-token) need the gke/eks providers via CLUSTERS_CONFIG instead.

environmentVariables.name: K8SCORTEX_STDIO_ROLES
environmentVariables.description: Roles for the session, e.g. developer for read-only tools. Defaults to platform-engineer.
